note: No queryable zoning district service found for Benton County MO. Warsaw (county seat) adopts zoning in its Unified Development Code (ecode360 Ch. 405) and says the official Zoning District Map is kept in the City Clerk's office; the city's Zoning Map link is not a usable service. The county assessor's GIS (bentoncogis.com) offers only parcels and imagery. The county hub has no zoning layer, and ArcGIS Online searches found no Benton County MO zoning layer. Only third-party zoneomics maps exist, which are not official.
